sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You may have a tendency to feel frustrated when the results are not the way you expected, feels Ganesha. You must still work hard and finish whatever you undertake today. You will discuss some vital issues with a close friend and relive cherished secrets with your life partner.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: If you find yourself tired and irritable at the moment, Taurus, you should know that this is normal. You may have had a few weeks that were a little too studious. Would you like to continue on the same path? Be careful that your ambitions don't lead you to serious physical exhaustion, Taurus. You'll be even more frustrated if you get sick. So be wise and take care of your basic needs.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Unhealthy dynamics intensify as the Scorpio Moon forms harsh squares with Jupiter and the nodes of fate. If you're determined to salvage certain bonds, establishing clear ground rules might be the only way forward. Lay boundaries to protect yourself from future drama, and be open to hearing others out as well. You'll have a better idea of who can or cannot evolve with you once Luna enters Sagittarius this evening. Applaud your ability to end toxic cycles when Neptune stirs tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Children will brighten your evening. Plan a nice dinner to adieu a dull and hectic day. Their company would recharge your body. Any of your movable property can get stolen today. Hence, you need to take good care of them. Your witty nature would brighten the environment around you. Your mastery in profession will be tested. You need to concentrate your efforts to give desired results. Today, you can sit with your family members and talk about many important issues of life. Your words may be bothersome for your family, but you will be able to derive a solution. Your plans might get disturbed due to an unexpected guest, but it will make your day.

readings.text: Cordial relations with colleagues will result in a comfortable work environment today. A comfortable setting might encourage you to work for the longer hours and put in more efforts. You will be in a mood to achieve productivity well before time, says Ganesha.

A new trend begins that will continue for the next few weeks. This trend spells difficulty in communication between you and the people you work with. The key to overcoming this time is to not be so aggressive and assertive towards others.

bits.t: You must still work hard and finish whatever you undertake today.

readings.text: You shall do a good job of getting your finances in order by balancing your assets and liabilities, says Ganesha. For instance, if you have taken loan, you will make an effort to pay it off in full.

This week is about your home, which may mean having to spend more to get good quality goods or an emergency plumber to fix a broken sink. Whatever the case, know that it's going to be better soon. Meanwhile, a supportive aspect transforms your dreams. Don't give up on that wild scheme yet. It may yield results soon.
Ganesha predicts that it is going to remain a very busy day for you and you will have to work very hard to finish off pending activities/assignments.You will have to take out time for relaxation.

It is obvious that all parents are so very fond of their children: it's having the opportunity to see the world through a child's eyes that pulls you out of your chair and onto the floor whenever you are around children. Getting on the floor may be harder and harder for your body, though! The first thing to think of when you aren't feeling your physical best is water - are you drinking enough every day? This element of a healthy lifestyle cannot be overstressed.

Their company would recharge your body.
Your witty nature would brighten the environment around you.

lucky.remedy: For excellent financial growth, drink copper-charged water (water stored in copper vessel).

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: If you want to make a change, do it. You can't wait for others to read your mind.
